entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant has been convicted for offences punishable under Section 376(1) of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment and fine of Rs.1,000/-, under Section 363 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for five years and fine of Rs.1,000/-, under Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for seven years and fine of Rs.1,000/-and under Section 4 of POCSO Act(sentenced incorporated in the sentenced for the offence under Section 376(1) of IPC) with default stipulations.
(according to application of the applicant) Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He further submits that although the prosecutrix is about 15 years of age but the medical report indicates signs suggestive of habitual sexual intercourse.
He further submits that there is no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and conclusion of appeal will take time.
The appellant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for 2 CRA-11729-2022 suspension of sentence may be allowed.
Learned counsel for State on the other hand has opposed the application and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial court.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant can be considered.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A. No.2757/2023 is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 19.02.2026 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
